study: Orchard Fold, a fictional Sussex garden room
datum: Metres from the south-west floor corner, x east, y true north, z up. All dimensions and trees invented.
activity: Breakfast and reading, 08:00 to 18:00 local time, daily. Aim for 18 to 26 degrees C for at least 95 percent of occupied hours in each season.
foliage: Ellipsoid deciduous crowns. Direct-beam transmission 0.18 May to September, 0.72 otherwise. Rounded canopy bounds and abrupt leaf-change dates are assumptions.
